decisions.reason: As the flagship organic line close to the core offer and central to the organic expansion strategy, it still has strategic value and costs little to keep, so the option stays open even though website visibility has faded.
Launched only in 2024 with its own page and built on the core sausage competence, its market value is still uncertain and keeping it is cheap, so the option remains open.
